description: Client-side script for handling address copying, UI toggling, and contact-related form interactions in the Contacts module of vtiger CRM.

methods.name: copyAddressRight
methods.description: Copies mailing address fields to other address fields in a form.

methods.name: copyAddressLeft
methods.description: Copies other address fields to mailing address fields in a form.

methods.name: toggleDisplay
methods.description: Toggles the display style of an HTML element between 'none' and 'inline'.

methods.name: set_return
methods.description: Sets the parent contact info in the opener window based on a selected product.

methods.name: add_data_to_relatedlist_incal
methods.description: Adds a contact ID and name to the related contacts list in the opener window.

methods.name: set_return_specific
methods.description: Sets contact name and ID in the opener window for detailed view.

methods.name: set_return_toDospecific
methods.description: Sets contact info in the opener window for Todo items.

methods.name: submitform
methods.description: Submits a mass delete form with a specified entity ID.

methods.name: searchMapLocation
methods.description: Opens Google Maps with the address details for the specified address type.

methods.name: set_return_contact_address
methods.description: Populates contact address fields in a form in the opener window, with confirmation for overwriting existing data.
